paramsSchema.description: Typed params for learning-algorithms / AstargraphOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

edges.description: Rendered undirected edges (weight in label); drawing only, A* reads wedges.

goal.description: Id of the target node; A* stops once it is expanded.

gscore.description: Best-known cost from start per node; start 0, others 9999 (infinity sentinel). Not rendered.

nodes.description: Graph vertices; A* recolours them slate→amber(open)→green(closed), blue=current, red=goal.

running.description: When true the tick expands one node per step; toggle to start/pause the search.

start.description: Id of the node A* searches from.

wedges.description: Undirected weighted adjacency A* relaxes; each weight exceeds its edge's straight-line length so the heuristic stays admissible.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

name.description: Optional rename of the inlined trait.

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

name.description: Canonical page name from the orbital.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field does the first load filter on?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field the INITIAL load filters on, paired with initialFilterValue. This is the detail half of a list-detail pair: a thread that must wait for a conversation to be picked sets the field to its parent key and leaves the value blank, so the first load matches nothing and the empty state shows instead of every record in the table. REFETCH_FILTER then supplies the real selection. Left blank the first load is unfiltered, which is the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: initial filter, first load filter, wait for selection, detail pane filter, requires selection, start empty

overridableConfigKeys.label: What value does the first load filter for?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The value initialFilterField must equal on the first load. Blank is meaningful: it matches only records whose field is itself blank, which for a detail pane is normally none — that is how a thread stays empty until its parent is selected.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: initial filter value, first load value, default selection

metaFormat.description: Typography format for the feed meta slot — date by default so the createdAt binding renders human-readable instead of raw ISO; set none for non-date bindings.

pageSize.description: Records fetched from the server per page request.
pageSize.x-label: How many rows to fetch per page?
pageSize.x-synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

priceBinding.description: Binding path for the price/amount overlay slot.

priorityBinding.description: Binding path for the priority slot.

scopeField.description: Name the field on this entity that holds the viewer's id (e.g. memberId, patientId, assignee). When set, the list loads ONLY rows whose that field equals @user.id — the 'my bookings' / 'my appointments' shape. Left blank the list loads every row, which is the default. Declared, never inferred: guessing the column from its name would silently scope the wrong one.
scopeField.x-label: Only show records owned by the signed-in user?
scopeField.x-synonyms: owner field, my records, only mine, only my own, scope to user, per-user list, mine only, owned by me

searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the list search box (e.g. 'Search orders…').
searchPlaceholder.x-synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

selectable.description: Adds a checkbox column with select-all to the dense table. Enable only when the surface offers bulk actions — checkboxes with nothing to act on are a dead affordance.
selectable.x-synonyms: row checkboxes, multi-select, bulk select, selection column

titleBinding.description: Binding path for the card title slot (e.g. @item.dishName).

default.className: rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-card)] shadow-sm overflow-hidden

triageBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = triage. Inbox-register queue: one surface with a toolbar search and compact list rows (title + badges + inline meta) built for keyboard-pace queue work; row actions collapse per maxInlineActions. Composes fields/itemActions/searchPlaceholder/bodySearch.

viewPattern.description: UI pattern used to render the collection. Used by the default bodyContent tree; Layer 3 variants override bodyContent directly instead and may ignore this knob.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty-state look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the empty-state placeholder.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Eviction policy
overridableConfigKeys.description: How entries are evicted when the cache fills: least-recently-used, least-frequently-used, first-in-first-out, or TTL-only (never evict early).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: cache replacement, eviction strategy

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max cache entries
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hard cap on cached entries before eviction. 0 = unlimited.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: cache capacity, max entries

overridableConfigKeys.label: Serve stale while revalidating
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, serve stale entries to consumers while a background refresh fetches fresh data. Reduces latency at the cost of brief staleness.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: SWR, stale serving

overridableConfigKeys.label: Table look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

overridableConfigKeys.label: TTL (seconds)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Cache entry time-to-live before it goes stale. Default 5 minutes. Shorter = fresher/real-time data; longer = stable/long-lived caching.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: expiration, time to live, cache duration, freshness, real-time (short) vs long-lived (long)

overridableConfigKeys.default: Fetch data to populate the cache.
Cache data is stale. Refresh to get the latest data.
Fetch data to populate the cache.

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for std-cache-aside / CacheEntryOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

events.name: RUN_EXACT
events.description: Starts the ladder at the exact-check rung (R0). request is the whole DECIDE payload, carried down the chain so each rung can project its own inputs.

events.name: DECIDE
events.description: Public entry point — decide the candidate, falling through the ladder until a rung can prove the answer. accepted is R1's table; categories is R3's comparison set (R5's closed label set is the ClassifyRung categories knob, a design-time decision rather than a per-request one).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Case sensitive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Compare candidate and key with case sensitivity; off lowercases both sides before comparing

overridableConfigKeys.label: Numeric tolerance
overridableConfigKeys.description: Absolute tolerance applied when both candidate and key are numbers; 0 requires an exact numeric match

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trim whitespace
overridableConfigKeys.description: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from both sides before comparing

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match field
overridableConfigKeys.description: When the accepted list holds objects rather than scalars, the field to compare against the candidate; empty compares each element itself

overridableConfigKeys.label: Normalize
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trim and lowercase both sides before comparing

overridableConfigKeys.label: Embedding model
overridableConfigKeys.description: Reserved for embedding-model selection; llm/embed takes only a texts array today, so this knob is not yet wired into the call

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match floor
overridableConfigKeys.description: Minimum cosine score for a confident match

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match margin
overridableConfigKeys.description: Minimum gap between the best and second-best score required to trust the match

overridableConfigKeys.label: Confidence floor
overridableConfigKeys.description: Minimum service-reported confidence required to answer; below this the atom abstains with reason low confidence

overridableConfigKeys.label: Model reference
overridableConfigKeys.description: hf:<id> for off-the-shelf weights, or a masar checkpoint id, forwarded to the ml service infer action

overridableConfigKeys.label: Output contract
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declared shape and per-dimension ranges the model output must satisfy; a failing check abstains with reason contract violation. Omit shape to assert ranges only — an empty shape [] asserts a SCALAR output, it does not mean unconstrained

overridableConfigKeys.label: Categories
overridableConfigKeys.description: Closed set of category labels the LLM must choose from

overridableConfigKeys.label: Model
overridableConfigKeys.description: Model override forwarded to the classify call

overridableConfigKeys.label: Provider
overridableConfigKeys.description: Reserved for provider selection; LLMServiceActions.classify (packages/almadar-llm/src/contracts.ts) takes no provider param today, so this knob is not forwarded to the call

events.name: DECIDED
events.description: The ladder proved an answer. rung names which one served it: R0 exact, R1 table, R3 retrieved, R4 learned, R5 generative.

events.name: DECISION_FAILED
events.description: Even the generative floor (R5) could not answer — the classify service call itself failed.

events.description: Data has been retrieved and processed for display.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aggregation
overridableConfigKeys.description: How values within a bucket combine into one number
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'count' / 'how many' -> count; 'total' / 'sum of' -> sum; 'average' / 'mean' -> avg; 'minimum' / 'lowest' -> min; 'maximum' / 'highest' -> max

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group / categorize / bucket / split by field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field whose values become the chart's category buckets. Set this when the user voices 'group by X' / 'categorize by X' / 'bucket by X' / 'split by X' / 'break down by X' for any non-time field X (for time-units, set period + timeAxis=true instead).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / categorize / breakdown by / split by / segment by. user phrases: 'group by status' -> categoryField=status; 'group by region' / 'by region' -> categoryField=region; 'group by category' / 'by category' -> categoryField=category; 'group by product' / 'by product' -> categoryField=product; 'group by month' / 'by month' -> categoryField=month (when explicitly requested as a category, not a time bucket); 'split by X' / 'break down by X' / 'segment by X' / 'bucket by X' -> categoryField=X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Chart type
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual format for the rendered chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: bar = vertical bars, line = connected line, pie = pie chart, donut = pie with hole, area = filled area chart, histogram = frequency distribution, scatter = XY scatter. user phrases: 'switch to donut' / 'make it a donut' / 'as a donut chart' -> donut; 'use a pie chart' -> pie; 'show as line' / 'line chart' -> line; 'as bars' / 'bar chart' -> bar

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drill event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when a user clicks a chart point
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: click-through navigation event. user phrases: 'on click navigate to X' / 'drill into X' / 'when clicked open X' -> X event name

overridableConfigKeys.label: Chart height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pixel height of the rendered chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: vertical size in pixels. user phrases: 'taller' / 'make it taller' / 'increase height' / 'bigger vertically' -> larger number (e.g. 300, 400); 'shorter' / 'smaller' -> smaller; 'set height to 300' / '300px tall' -> 300

overridableConfigKeys.label: Top N
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keep only the first N points after sorting (0 = all)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'top 5' -> 5; 'top 10' -> 10; 'first 3' -> 3; 'all' / 'no limit' -> 0; 'show all' -> 0

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group by month / quarter / week / day / year
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group by month, quarter, week, day, or year — the calendar bucket the chart groups data into. Set ALONGSIDE timeAxis=true whenever the user says 'group by <time-unit>' or 'by <time-unit>' or 'rebucket to <time-unit>' or 'instead of <other-time-unit>'.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / change bucket / group differently. user phrases: 'group by month' / 'by month' / 'monthly' / 'monthly buckets' / 'switch to monthly' / 'instead of quarter' -> month; 'group by quarter' / 'by quarter' / 'quarterly' -> quarter; 'group by week' / 'by week' / 'weekly' / 'weekly buckets' -> week; 'group by day' / 'by day' / 'daily' / 'daily buckets' -> day; 'group by year' / 'by year' / 'yearly' / 'annually' -> year. Whenever the user voices 'group by <time-unit>' BOTH period AND timeAxis=true should be set.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Series
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pre-formatted multi-series spec for stacked or layered charts
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: multiple lines / bars per category. user phrases: 'compare X and Y' -> add two series entries

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show legend
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: true shows the color key. user phrases: 'show legend' / 'show the legend' / 'show key' / 'with legend' / 'with a legend' -> true; 'hide legend' / 'no legend' / 'without legend' / 'remove legend' -> false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show values
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render the numeric value on top of each data point
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'show values' / 'show numbers on bars' / 'with data labels' / 'label the bars' -> true; 'hide values' / 'no labels' -> false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort direction
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ascending or descending order for the sort field
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: asc = ascending = lowest-to-highest = low-to-high = smallest-first. desc = descending = highest-to-lowest = high-to-low = largest-first. user phrases: 'highest to lowest' / 'largest first' / 'descending' -> desc; 'lowest to highest' / 'smallest first' / 'ascending' -> asc

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort by
overridableConfigKeys.description: Order points by value, label, or leave unsorted
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'sort by value' / 'order by amount' -> value; 'sort alphabetically' / 'sort by name' -> label; 'no sort' / 'leave order' -> none

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stacking
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stack bars, normalize to 100%, or render side-by-side
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: user phrases: 'side by side' / 'grouped' -> none; 'stacked' / 'stack the bars' -> stack; 'percent stacked' / '100% stacked' / 'normalized' -> normalize

overridableConfigKeys.label: Subtitle
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: secondary header below the title. user phrases: 'with subtitle X' / 'set subtitle to X' -> X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Time axis
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group by timeField bucketed by period instead of categoryField
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: true means group by date / month / time. user phrases: 'group by month / week / year / date' -> set timeAxis=true; 'group by status / category' -> timeAxis=false

overridableConfigKeys.label: Date field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field used as the time axis when timeAxis is on
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the date / timestamp / created-at column. set when timeAxis=true

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the chart's header text. user phrases: 'rename to X' / 'title it X' / 'change the title to X' / 'call it X' -> X

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Numeric field aggregated per bucket (blank = row count)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: the numeric column to aggregate. empty string counts rows. user phrases: 'sum revenue' -> valueField=revenue + aggregation=sum

overridableConfigKeys.label: Render pattern
overridableConfigKeys.description: UI pattern used to draw the chart
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: internal pattern selector. user prompts rarely target this directly — pattern selection is upstream

fields.name: source
fields.description: ImportSource descriptor of the run (kind + options), supplied by the host.

fields.name: files
fields.description: Client-side file metadata for upload sources (name/size/type/lastModified).

fields.name: target
fields.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle position of the run.

fields.name: documents
fields.description: Document metadata listed from the source.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Most recently fetched document content.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: Staged/committed/failed/skipped counts.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Failure detail when status is failed.

events.name: DOCUMENTS_LISTED
events.description: migration.listDocuments service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: DOCUMENT_FETCHED
events.description: migration.fetchDocument service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor

events.name: COMMITTED
events.description: migration.commit service result — committed count plus per-unit failures

events.name: MIGRATION_CALL_FAILED
events.description: migration service call failure signal — lands the run in failed, never a silent swallow

events.name: MIGRATION_FETCHED
events.description: Source documents are listed and the run is ready for staging (deterministic pipeline or agent)
events.synonyms: import fetched, source listed, documents ready

events.name: MIGRATION_DOCUMENT
events.description: A single fetched document's content, for the host staging layer to map into target units

events.name: MIGRATION_REVIEW_READY
events.description: Staging is complete; the preview is ready for the approval gate
events.synonyms: preview ready, staging complete, review import

events.name: MIGRATION_COMPLETED
events.description: The commit drained through the host sink; stats carry committed and per-unit failed counts
events.synonyms: import done, migration complete, data imported

events.name: MIGRATION_FAILED
events.description: The run failed; error carries the service-reported detail and the terminal job row was persisted

events.name: MIGRATION_START
events.description: Starts an import run. source is the ImportSource descriptor; files carries client file metadata for upload sources. Also reached via a sibling std-import's IMPORT_REQUESTED.
events.synonyms: start import, run migration, import data

events.name: FETCH_DOCUMENT
events.description: Fetch one document's full content from the source during staging

events.name: MIGRATION_STAGED
events.description: Host staging finished — units are staged and validated; stats summarize staged/skipped counts for the preview

events.name: MIGRATION_DISCARDED
events.description: The run was discarded before commit

events.name: MIGRATION_APPROVED
events.description: The user approved the preview; units are the staged ImportUnits to commit through the host sink

events.name: MIGRATION_REJECTED
events.description: The user sent the preview back for more staging

events.name: RESET
events.description: Returns the job to idle from a terminal state

events.name: MIGRATION_RETRY
events.description: Re-runs the fetch after a failure, with the same source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Connection reference
overridableConfigKeys.description: Secret-store / environment KEY holding the source credentials. The reference is stored; the secret itself never enters config, traces, or snapshots — the migration service resolves it at run time. (Typed `string` until the `secret` config-field type lands in the lolo language — tracked gap.)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: credential key, connection string reference, secret name

overridableConfigKeys.label: Target entity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into (e.g. the organism's own entity). The migration service derives the full target descriptor from the running app's schema.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: destination, import into, target type

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

fields.name: alpha
fields.description: Beta distribution success count (prior + observed successes).

fields.name: beta
fields.description: Beta distribution failure count (prior + observed failures).

fields.name: mean
fields.description: Posterior mean: alpha / (alpha + beta).

fields.name: intervalLow
fields.description: Lower bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: intervalHigh
fields.description: Upper bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: observations
fields.description: Number of observations folded into the posterior so far.

events.name: MASTERY_REACHED
events.description: The posterior mean clears masteryFloor with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: REMEDIATION_NEEDED
events.description: The posterior mean is at or below remediationCeiling with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
events.description: The abstain — the credible interval is still wider than intervalWidthMax, so no verdict is licensed yet.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max credible-interval width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Above this width the posterior is too uncertain to decide — abstain with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Mastery floor
overridableConfigKeys.description: Posterior mean at or above this, with a tight interval, licenses MASTERY_REACHED.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Prior alpha
overridableConfigKeys.description: Beta prior success pseudo-count before any observation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Prior beta
overridableConfigKeys.description: Beta prior failure pseudo-count before any observation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Remediation ceiling
overridableConfigKeys.description: Posterior mean at or below this, with a tight interval, licenses REMEDIATION_NEEDED.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Posterior sample count
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of Monte Carlo draws from the Beta posterior used to estimate the credible interval.

bodies.description: 16 small equal-mass particles spread across the box with varied velocities — the ideal-gas ensemble.

height.description: Simulation height in pixels; bounds the wall bounce.

running.description: When true the tick integrates; toggle to start/pause the sim.

showVelocity.description: Draw each body's velocity vector as an arrow.

velocityScale.description: Length multiplier for the velocity arrows.

width.description: Simulation width in pixels; bounds the wall bounce.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for std-status-lifecycle / StatusLifecycleOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

collection.description: Override the persistence collection / table name. Defaults to `plural(entityName).toLowerCase()`. Use this when the user names the database/table/storage location ("save them under X", "the table is called X", "in our database it's X") — NOT when they rename the domain concept (that's `entityName`).

persistence.description: Override the entity persistence mode. `persistent` = stored in the configured backend; `runtime` = in-memory session-scoped only.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Background Image
overridableConfigKeys.description: Background image (tiled behind iso/hex/flat/free; cover-scaled for atlas slices). A bare URL string is accepted as shorthand for a standalone backdrop.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Camera Pos
overridableConfigKeys.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Children
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fit
overridableConfigKeys.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Follow Target
overridableConfigKeys.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Key Up Map
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Scale
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Hover Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Leave Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tile Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Unit Click Event

backgroundImage.description: Background image (tiled behind iso/hex/flat/free; cover-scaled for atlas slices). A bare URL string is accepted as shorthand for a standalone backdrop.

cameraPos.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.

children.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.

fit.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.

followTarget.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.

keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input).

keyUpMap.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event.

scale.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).

tileHoverEvent.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.

tileLeaveEvent.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.

tileWidth.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Editable
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, render an editable surface that composes a transparent `Textarea` over a Prism-highlighted overlay. The overlay re-tokenizes on each keystroke (driven from a local mirror of the textarea value), so users see syntax-highlighted code while still being able to type. Folding is skipped in editable mode. History: GAP-51 first-cut shipped plain (no-highlighting) editable text; GAP-77 (2026-04-12) added the Prism overlay layer. Default: false (existing read-only behavior unchanged).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Animation
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keyframe animation over the group TRANSFORM tracks (`offsetX/Y/Z` in cells, `rotateX/Y/Z` in radians, `scale`; the 2D painter also honors `opacity`) — children inherit it, so nested animated groups form a joint chain. Material tracks belong on leaf meshes.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bone
overridableConfigKeys.description: Skeleton bone name. A named group is addressable by a `draw-mesh` `skin` block (smooth skinning): the skinned mesh deforms with this group's animated transform. Names resolve within the nearest enclosing `skeleton: true` group (falling back to the canvas), so multiple instances of one rig never collide. Distinct from `id` (the hit-test handle).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Clip
overridableConfigKeys.description: Clip the group's items to an SVG path (`d` syntax) in world units relative to the group origin — masked reveals, meters, portraits.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Items
overridableConfigKeys.description: The grouped drawables, painted through the normal dispatch.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position
overridableConfigKeys.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rotation

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for ui-form / FormOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

sections.description: Nested form sections with optional conditions

title.description: Form title (used by ModalSlot to extract title)

violationTriggers.description: Violation conditions that emit VIOLATION_DETECTED when met (boolean true means enabled but config loaded separately)

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

cols.description: Number of columns (can be responsive object)

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

name.description: Optional rename of the inlined trait.

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

name.description: Canonical page name from the orbital.

Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

asRoot.description: When true (default), wraps in a standalone <svg> so the shape is visible without a parent SVG context.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

name.description: Optional rename of the inlined trait.

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

name.description: Canonical page name from the orbital.

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

events.name: ITEM_CLICK
events.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract.

events.name: SELECT
events.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { ids, rows }.

events.name: SORT
events.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

events.name: VIEW
events.description: User opened a record from the list.

events.name: TableViewLoaded
events.description: TableView rows finished loading; payload.data holds the collection.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Accepts
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the table root.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: Column definitions. The compiler emits `columns`; `fields` is the alias.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Item Id Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Root
overridableConfigKeys.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drag Group
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drop Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Message
overridableConfigKeys.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group By
overridableConfigKeys.description: Group rows under section headers by a field value.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Item Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the data-list / entity-table look enum so authors share one knob name across row renderers.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Inline Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max rows before a 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (show all).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reorder Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Select Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { ids, rows }.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selectable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render a leading checkbox column. Selection changes emit `selectEvent`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selected Ids
overridableConfigKeys.description: Currently-selected ids (controlled). Falls back to local state when omitted.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort Column
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current sort column (display hint for the active header arrow).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sortable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

signatures.capabilities: admin console table, records list, CRUD data table, user list, manage-users grid, sortable columns, row selection with bulk actions, grouped list view

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for ui-table-view / TableViewOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the table root.

columns.description: Column definitions. The compiler emits `columns`; `fields` is the alias.

dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

fields.description: Alias for `columns`.

groupBy.description: Group rows under section headers by a field value.

itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract.

look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the data-list / entity-table look enum so authors share one knob name across row renderers.

maxInlineActions.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

pageSize.description: Max rows before a 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (show all).

positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

selectEvent.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { ids, rows }.

selectable.description: Render a leading checkbox column. Selection changes emit `selectEvent`.

selectedIds.description: Currently-selected ids (controlled). Falls back to local state when omitted.

sortColumn.description: Current sort column (display hint for the active header arrow).

sortEvent.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.

name.description: Optional rename of the inlined trait.

pages.description: Per-page overrides keyed by canonical page name.

name.description: Canonical page name from the orbital.

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

theme.description: Theme key — the full `data-theme` value applied to the layout root (e.g. linear-clean-light, terminal-dark, game-adventure-dark). Plan-level: pick ONE for the whole app — it is threaded to every orbital. Omit to leave the factory default.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Step Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative step click event — emits UI:{stepClickEvent} with { stepIndex }. Setting it requires declaring that event (with a `{ stepIndex }` payload) and a transition handling it in the same trait; omit this prop for non-clickable progress indicators.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Steps
overridableConfigKeys.description: Step definitions (compatible with WizardContainer's WizardStep). A string is shorthand for `{ id: str, title: str }`.

paramsSchema.description: Typed params for ui-wizard-progress / WizardProgressOrbital. Empty {} = factory defaults.

entityName.description: PascalCase singular entity rename (e.g. "Listing", "Member"). Renames the DOMAIN concept and rewrites every `@Entity.*` reference. Use this when the user wants to rename the THING, not where it's stored.

pagePath.description: URL path override for the orbital's first page.

fields.description: Extra entity fields appended to the canonical entity. Caller wins on name collision.

relation.description: Relation target. `cardinality: "one"` for FK (customerId → one Customer); "many" for collection (tags → many Tag).

traitOverrides.description: Per-trait knob overrides keyed on the canonical trait name. Each value can include `config` (knob values), `linkedEntity` (rebind), `events` (per-key rename map), `listens` (cross-orbital subscriptions), `emitsScope` (`internal` keeps emits local; `external` lets sibling orbitals listen), and `name` (rename the inlined trait). Only the traits + knobs shown here are valid — the schema rejects unknown keys.

allowNavigation.description: Allow clicking on completed steps to navigate back

onStepClick.description: Callback when a completed step is clicked

stepClickEvent.description: Declarative step click event — emits UI:{stepClickEvent} with { stepIndex }. Setting it requires declaring that event (with a `{ stepIndex }` payload) and a transition handling it in the same trait; omit this prop for non-clickable progress indicators.

steps.description: Step definitions (compatible with WizardContainer's WizardStep). A string is shorthand for `{ id: str, title: str }`.

linkedEntity.description: Rebind this trait to a different entity in the organism (rewrites every @entity.* / ref / fetch / persist binding inside it).

name.description: Rename the inlined trait at the call site. Does NOT change topology — just the trait's local name.

events.description: Per-key event rename map (e.g. `{ "OPEN": "ADD_ITEM" }`). Rewrites the events array, transition triggers, emit/listen event keys, and `["emit", X]` SExpression literals inside the trait.

event.description: Event key to subscribe to (bare name, no orbital prefix).

triggers.description: Local state-machine event fired when the subscription matches. Must be one of the events this trait's own transitions already react to.

scope.description: `internal` = same-orbital events. `external` = events from sibling orbitals (use this for cross-orbital reactivity).

listens.description: Replace this trait's `listens` entirely. Empty array clears upstream listeners. For cross-orbital reactivity, add an entry with `scope: "external"` matching the source orbital's emit event.

emitsScope.description: `internal` = emits stay local to this orbital. `external` = sibling orbitals can listen. Set to `external` when another orbital needs to react to this trait's events (counter updates, list refreshes, badges, etc.).

extraTraits.description: Sibling traits to compose beyond the factory-authored stack.
